verdict.rationale: Weave documents a dedicated endpoint that accepts OTLP-formatted trace data directly into a project. It is designed to sit alongside an existing OTel observability pipeline rather than replace it, and Weave also offers an OTel-compatible SDK for agent harnesses. Missing for 10: evidence of exporting or receiving traces back out of Weave over OTLP, details on transport and protocol specifics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
